capabilities: render interactive graphs from YAML code blocks
plot mathematical functions including derivatives and vector fields
disambiguation: Not the vault graph view; it plots mathematical functions and data, not notes and links.
extras: README covers only basics and points to the Graphs Wiki for more documentation; bug reports go through GitHub issues.
problem: Obsidian has no built-in way to plot mathematical functions or data as interactive graphs within a note.
summary: Chart renderer that creates interactive 2D and 3D mathematical graphs inside notes from YAML written in graph code blocks.
